headline: Directs the Forest Service to swap about 4 acres of Ouachita National Forest land for about 6.3 acres of land owned by Walnut Grove Church in Garland County, Arkansas, if the church offers.
what_it_does: If Walnut Grove Church offers to give the federal government about 6.3 acres of its land (Offered Tract 5742), the Department of Agriculture must accept it and give the church about 4 acres of Ouachita National Forest land (Selected Tract 5743) in return. The two parcels must be of equal value, or the difference must be made up with a cash payment, unless the church's land is worth more than the forest land. The summary provided covers only Section 3 of the bill, so other sections are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Walnut Grove Church in Garland County, Arkansas
who_it_affects.how: The church would give up about 6.3 acres of its land and receive about 4 acres of Ouachita National Forest land, if it chooses to make the offer.

who_it_affects.group: The Forest Service and the public who use the Ouachita National Forest
who_it_affects.how: The federal government would take ownership of the church's land and give up about 4 acres of forest land, changing the forest's boundaries and land holdings.

when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted December 21, 2018, but the exchange only happens if the church makes an offer. The summary does not give a deadline for that offer.
